answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Roskilde; brief asks for levels, lifts and entrances)
answers.answer: Street/platform level plus pedestrian tunnels under the tracks. DSB confirms stairs and elevator access; Wikipedia says elevators were installed 1998–2002. OSM maps two tunnels (middle, by the station building; and west) and only two lifts, both at the west tunnel (platform 1 side and perron 2).

open: Lifts to perron 3 (tracks 4/5) and perron 4 (tracks 6/7): DSB and Wikipedia confirm elevators exist but not how many or where; OSM has only two lifts (platform 1 side and perron 2, west tunnel).
Signposted names of the two tunnels and of any level: no owner source found.
No ticket office (DSB Salg & Service) mentioned by DSB; Wikipedia says the 7-Eleven is a combined ticket office/shop.
Toilet hours: DSB says only 'locked in the evening and at night'.
No owner station plan found (DSB, Banedanmark, Movia).
Floor heights / tunnel depth: no source measures them.
